answer: DNS Spoofing works by manipulating DNS settings to redirect users from legitimate sites to malicious ones or to prevent access to those sites altogether. This can enable adversaries to conduct further malicious activities, such as intercepting user credentials or pushing additional malware. The manipulation of DNS can occur through various methods, allowing attackers to leverage their position for these purposes [Source 1][Source 2].
